domains.name: Reference Data: Pricing & Model Catalog
domains.responsibility: Denominations and exchange rates: canonical prices, authored per-model facts and capabilities, lane/registry SSOTs, money scale, and the sync/refresh paths that author them.

domains.name: Configuration
domains.responsibility: Declarative settings registry and resolved runtime config (paths, knobs, key loading).

domains.name: Money Ledger
domains.responsibility: Money truth: spend_events schema, single-owner hash-chained writer, migrations, indexes, fork-safe locks, rollups, WAL upkeep, dead-letter replay, legacy-charge migration.

domains.name: Spend Search
domains.responsibility: Bounded, admission-counted, read-only ledger queries with per-request deadlines shared by every skin.

domains.name: Call Corpus & Content Retention
domains.responsibility: MISSING in seed. Per-call context/quality corpus (calls, call_io), age-bounded complete content tier, lossless compression, routing-audit metadata. Distinct system of record from money: it holds prompts/outputs and evidence, not $.

domains.name: Spend Capture & Ingestion
domains.responsibility: MISSING in seed. Turns spend that happens OUTSIDE spendguard's own execution into ledger/corpus rows: SDK/LiteLLM/HTTP/OTel capture, transcript miners (Claude Code, Codex, claude.ai), the transcript-source and GPU ports with their provider adapters, historical backfill, first-run scan.

domains.name: Execution
domains.responsibility: Spends tokens: provider registry and typed vendor calls, batch submit and batch-job lifecycle, and the subscription-lane executors (one-shot CLI runs on flat-fee plans), plus the provider plugin contract.

domains.name: Work Integrity
domains.responsibility: MISSING in seed. Correctness contracts on produced work, independent of how it is routed: every item ends in a named state, resume never re-buys or reuses stale output, outputs match a declared shape, files enter prompts whole, exactly-once terminal journal, commit assertions, bulk resilience rule.

domains.name: Cost Estimation
domains.responsibility: MISSING in seed. Pre-spend projection: input/output token counting per provider and modality, naive estimate, learned calibration, estimate-vs-bill divergence. Sits BELOW admission (the gate consumes it) and is not post-hoc measurement.

domains.name: Admission & Enforcement
domains.responsibility: The allow/deny/defer decision per call or job: pre-submit cap gate, test-first/estimate-first bulk gate, escalation admission, exhausted-plan admission, model preflight, disk reserve, host-agent hooks (spawn, weekly cap, residency), and the cache short-circuit.

domains.name: Routing
domains.responsibility: Which wallet pays: target utility scores, marginal-cost economic routing, horizon allocation across lane/batch/realtime, cascade escalation, best-value (model,effort) resolution, lane load sensing, bulk-tier routing config.

domains.name: Token Operations
domains.responsibility: Cross-call live resource management: dispatch governor, cross-process rate reservation, durable lane queue and predictive planner, storm coalescing, delegation (router, durable jobs, detached worker, worktree isolation, reaper), warm-daemon pools and broker, persisted per-resource state, lane fail-over evidence, corpus fan-out.

domains.name: Treasury / Valuation
domains.responsibility: Values money at spend time: metered prepay balances (sunk vs auto-reload), plan quota and headroom (Stored-value), plan economics and $/token, plan value, paid overage (Arrears).

domains.name: Measurement & Experimentation
domains.responsibility: Produces empirical evidence: judged readings with provenance, bakeoffs, compare, A/B lab, equivalence ladder, requirement judge, stability, effort titration, reachability, servability, realized routing/efficiency, guarded-savings distribution, cache audit/test, prompt lint, practice review, lane eligibility.

domains.name: Learning & Advisory
domains.responsibility: Turns evidence into learnings and advice: insights + temporal learning graph, re-validation, decaying contextual bandit, cold-start prior, deterministic and LLM advisors, post-event conversation/history mining, cold-start bootstrap, plan brief.

domains.name: Reconciliation & Attribution
domains.responsibility: Forensic accounting against provider truth (one reconcile loop + per-provider reconcilers, gap ownership, offline owner, admin-usage oracle, trust check, cost-axis integrity, anomaly z-scores) and the third axis: org→team×project attribution, tagging, work-done context.

domains.name: Spend Reporting
domains.responsibility: MISSING as a clean home in seed (it was implied in Surfaces). Owns report computation: unified daily/weekly/monthly report and monthly close statement. Not a facade: it computes totals.

domains.name: Assurance & Self-Verification
domains.responsibility: MISSING in seed. Checks spendguard's own code and installation, not money: price-literal and token-cap scans with a model-verdict store, key-shadow and venv coverage audits, consumer audit, metadata drift, forensic verify, architectural fitness, readiness gates, ledger benchmarks, source compaction for review.

domains.name: Federation & Egress
domains.responsibility: MISSING in seed (seed put orgsync in Surfaces). Everything that leaves the machine: client-side de-identification, SaaS seam, scrubbed efficiency signal and shared insights, event sinks, email, FOCUS export. Owns scrubbing/projection logic, so it cannot be a thin INTERFACE.

domains.name: Platform: Install, Fleet & Release
domains.responsibility: MISSING in seed AND missing from the capability spine. Self-operation of the product: version SSOT, release green pointer, distribution attestation, manifest, fleet convergence, OS scheduler, init/config interview, lane activation, interpreter gating via run/remote, offline build provisioning, launchd labels.

domains.name: Surfaces
domains.responsibility: Thin facades over the capability SSOT: cli, __main__, MCP server and its descriptor lifecycle, HTTP serve, the stable ask() facade, capability registry and generated CLI/API/MCP/doc projections, shared UI strings.

missing_domains_found.name: Spend Capture & Ingestion
missing_domains_found.why: Observing spend generated OUTSIDE spendguard (SDK/LiteLLM/HTTP/OTel capture, transcript miners, GPU port + adapters, backfill) is neither Execution (spends nothing) nor Ledger (it feeds it). v1/seed smeared these across Execution and Surfaces.

missing_domains_found.name: Call Corpus & Content Retention
missing_domains_found.why: A second system of record (prompts/outputs/evidence) with its own privacy and retention rules; not money, so it cannot live in Ledger.

missing_domains_found.name: Cost Estimation
missing_domains_found.why: Pre-spend projection consumed by the gate (gate->estimate_divergence, bulkgate->calibrate). The seed put calibrate in Measurement, which would make Admission depend on L2 and break the loop.

missing_domains_found.name: Work Integrity
missing_domains_found.why: Item-completeness, resume fingerprinting, output contracts, exactly-once journal: correctness of produced work regardless of route. No seed domain owns correctness.

missing_domains_found.name: Learning & Advisory (split out of seed 'Measurement & Learning')
missing_domains_found.why: The loop the prompt mandates names measurement and learning as separate stages; one domain hides the measurement->learning edge.

missing_domains_found.name: Spend Reporting
missing_domains_found.why: report/close compute totals; putting them in Surfaces would violate rule 4.

missing_domains_found.name: Assurance & Self-Verification
missing_domains_found.why: 15 modules verify spendguard's OWN code/install (price-literal scans, token caps, readiness, fitness, verify). They analyze code, not money, so Reconciliation is not a clean fit.

missing_domains_found.name: Federation & Egress
missing_domains_found.why: deid/saas/signal/share/emit/notify/focus_export own scrubbing and projection logic, so they are not thin INTERFACE. Needs a kind of its own (EGRESS).

missing_domains_found.name: Platform: Install, Fleet & Release
missing_domains_found.why: Version SSOT, green pointer, attestation, fleet convergence, scheduler, init, run/remote gating. None of the five capability kinds covers the product operating itself, so a sixth kind (PLATFORM) is missing from the spine.

notes: SEED VERDICT: partially confirmed. Confirmed: the capability-kind spine; Ledger/Spend Search/Execution/Routing/Token Operations/Treasury/Reconciliation as real contexts; all 7 economics probes now have clean homes (lane_bandit->Learning & Advisory as the learning write-path; route_realized->Measurement; route_horizon->Routing; weekly_cap_guard->Admission; whole_job split Routing/Token Ops; lane_quota_cost split Treasury/Admission; overage->Treasury as the Arrears account, NOT Reconciliation, because overage.py is live status, not forensics). Refuted: (a) 10 domains is too few. 21 are needed, and 9 of them are missing from the seed; (b) Routing and Admission are different decisions (which wallet vs allow/deny) and are split; (c) best_value goes to Routing, not Treasury: it SELECTS (model,effort) from valuations, it does not value; (d) orgsync is not an interface; (e) the five kinds are incomplete: EGRESS and PLATFORM are missing. PHANTOM SEED MODULES: executors, bulk_delegate, utilization, determinism, money-ledger, connection pool, savings analytics do not exist in the 220-module corpus. Either they are planned or they were renamed (e.g. savings is guard.py, determinism lives in stability.py/adapters measurement=True). SPLITS: 12 real multi-responsibility modules (vs 106 flagged in v1). Biggest is adapters.py (~90 defs: execution + live lane-health state + routing defaults + capability facts). Its lane-cooling state should move into resource_state. ACYCLICITY IS VIOLATED TODAY: one 30-module SCC spans ledger, ledger_writer, ledger_read, budget, gate, config, config_schema, calls, fleet, distribution, distribution_daemon, manifest, setup, mcp_server, mcp_fd_lifecycle, receipt, residency_gate, weekly_cap_guard, lane_queue, the codex daemon/broker/exec stack, delegate_jobs/router, execution_journal, disk_guard, ledger_deadletter, ledger_request_cursor, ledger_wal_maintenance. Edges to cut, in order: budget<->gate and budget->distribution (move cap-check out of budget into Admission); config->ledger_* and config_schema->fleet/residency_gate/weekly_cap_guard (L0 must import nothing above it; invert to registration); ledger_writer->ledger_read and ledger_read->calls/budget (store-write must not import its search; read must not import corpus/admission); adapters->distribution and distribution_daemon->mcp_server (execution/platform must not import a surface); execution_journal<->delegate_jobs. META-LOOP: advisor, bakeoff, experiment, effort_titration, cacheaudit, cachetest, conv, review and intent_model_prior import submit (Execution), so analysis buys its own judge calls. This is a nested, meta-budgeted loop, not a violation of data flow, but at the import level it is a back-edge Execution<-Analyze. Expose a caged 'meta-call' port from Execution and depend on that. bulkgate->advisor is a real violation: Admission must consume a calibrated estimate, not the learning advisor. RULE 4 AT SCALE: 76 non-surface modules import capability_cli_parsing and define main(). The capability modules own their CLI, so the facades are not thin. Move main() bodies into generated projections. HUB: 185 modules import the package root `spendguard`, whose __init__ eagerly imports gate/calls/pricing/etc. and installs the gate on import. That makes every module transitively depend on everything; the __init__ split (facade vs auto-install side effect) is the single highest-leverage fix. Configuration has one wholly-owned module (config_schema) because config.py is split. This is intentional: config.py's ledger wiring is the defect.
